items.text: You can now pre-warm an OpenAI-hosted sandbox before attaching it to an Agents API session. Prewarming improves latency by creating and configuring the sandbox before a user finishes sending their message. This means the user doesn't have to wait for all this work to complete. OpenAI-hosted sandbox compute is now billed during active turns. You no longer pay for idle time between turns.

items.title: Faster steering in Codex
items.text: We’re rolling out faster steering in Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app. When you send a follow-up to steer a running task, Codex can respond to your changes sooner. Use steering to correct an approach, add missing information, or change direction while Codex works. You can choose whether follow-up messages steer the current run or wait for the next one in Settings → General → Follow-up behavior . Learn more in Using Codex with your ChatGPT plan .
